name: Stormpunk
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium portrait playing-card BACK ARTWORK for BALÍK, precisely 5:7 aspect ratio, front-on flat full-bleed opaque rectangular artwork, no external tabletop, no perspective mockup. Input images are STYLE references only: match their confident ink outlines, dimensional comic cel shading, warm metal highlights and strong game-ready graphic masses. A new original ornamental design for STORMPUNK: four urban factions united in one weather-beaten industrial power seal, NOT a pasted sticker or a face card. Deep midnight blue-black enamel ground. A strong central ivory and aged brass industrial plaque, very clear and large. EXACTLY one text element: 'BALÍK', uppercase heavy sculptural serif, B A L Í K, preserve the acute accent above Í, no other text at all. A broad circular dynamo behind the plaque unites red glowing furnace heat, golden wing-shaped transit fins, a few bold green rooftop leaves threading through steel, and vivid electric blue storm arcs. Upper and lower relief ornaments balance the central logo; two broad copper conductor loops and dark riveted steel braces form a readable inner frame. Four colors balanced across one engineered machine, large interlocking shapes with real construction and scuffed materials, white-hot energy core peeking around the plaque, selective dramatic warm/cool rim light and deep shadows. Elegant premium collectible comic feel consistent with the reference art, energetic and urban, not fantasy filigree, not a generic gears wallpaper. Keep inner frame and all important shapes at least 8 percent inside edges, full background extends to every edge. Readable at 76px card width. No character, no human, no rank, no number, no corner indices, no suit glyphs, no other words, no watermark, no outer white margin. No photorealism or clay toy style. The word BALÍK is the largest focal element.

export.method: Sharp resize/encode only; no drawing or text compositing
